We are excited to share an update: the product now includes a shared project calendar. Colleagues can use the calendar as a common place to view upcoming work and see that information together.

Shared work benefits from a shared view. With the calendar available in the product, colleagues have a place to look when they want to understand what is coming up. The update is designed around the idea that information is more useful when people can access a common view as they coordinate with each other.

We also know that the experience of using a shared calendar can look different from team to team. That is why we welcome feedback from colleagues who use it. Your perspective can help us understand what is useful and what you need from a shared view of upcoming work.

We hope this update makes it easier to bring conversations about upcoming work into a shared space. We look forward to hearing how the calendar fits into the way you and your colleagues work together.
